title: Ukuvinjezelwa Ngaphansi Kwesibhakabhaka Esingazelelwe
intro: Umi phambi kwebutho elinamandla elisondela endaweni ehloniphekile, zonke izikhali sezilungile futhi ukunqoba kubonakala kuqinisekile. Ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ukuhlasela, kuvela amandla angalindelekile, futhi umncintiswano uthatha ijika okungekho muntu owalibona kusengaphambili.
clues: Sahamba ngokuqiniseka ukuthi akukho mandla asemhlabeni anganyakazisa.
Silethe izindlovu ezinamandla, futhi amandla ethu abonakala sengathi akhiwe nxazonke zazo.
Sasize ukuzobhidliza indawo engcwele ehlonishwayo, sikholelwa ukuthi ukunqoba kwethu kwase kuqinisekisiwe kakade.
Lapho sifika kuyo, umhlambi wehla esibhakabhakeni ngaphezu kwethu.
Izinyoni zaphonsa amatshe obumba oluqinile kumaqhawe ethu.
Sanqotshwa ngokuphelele kangangokuthi amandla ethu amakhulu aqhekeka futhi ahlakazeka njengomlotha.
